SELECT e.exhibit_code AS east_exhibit, w.exhibit_code AS west_exhibit, e.east_visits + w.west_visits AS forecast_visits, east.source_id AS east_source, west.source_id AS west_source
FROM east JOIN exhibit AS e ON e.load_kg <= east.rated_kg
CROSS JOIN west JOIN exhibit AS w ON w.load_kg <= west.rated_kg

  "decision-assign-festival-crates-to-return-bays": "WITH feasible AS (
  SELECT g.group_key, b.bay_key, g.crate_qty * r.metres AS crate_metres
  FROM carry_route AS r
  JOIN crate_group AS g ON g.group_key = r.group_key
  JOIN return_bay AS b ON b.bay_key = r.bay_key
  WHERE g.crate_qty <= b.crate_limit
), best AS (
  SELECT a.group_key AS g1, a.bay_key AS b1, a.crate_metres AS m1, b.group_key AS g2, b.bay_key AS b2, b.crate_metres AS m2
  FROM feasible AS a JOIN feasible AS b ON a.group_key COLLATE BINARY < b.group_key AND a.bay_key <> b.bay_key
  ORDER BY a.crate_metres + b.crate_metres, a.bay_key COLLATE BINARY, b.bay_key COLLATE BINARY
  LIMIT 1
)

  "decision-assign-grain-sensitive-blanks-to-remnants": "WITH options(slot_no, slip_id, source_id, cost, consumed) AS (
  SELECT slot_no, slip_id, 'BUY', buy_cents, 0 FROM cut_slip
  UNION ALL
  SELECT s.slot_no, s.slip_id, r.remnant_id, 0, 1
  FROM cut_slip AS s JOIN paper_remnant AS r
    ON (r.sheet_w >= s.blank_w AND r.sheet_h >= s.blank_h)
    OR (s.turn_ok = 1 AND r.sheet_w >= s.blank_h AND r.sheet_h >= s.blank_w)
)
SELECT a.slip_id AS slip_one, a.source_id AS source_one, b.slip_id AS slip_two, b.source_id AS source_two, a.cost + b.cost AS purchase_cents
FROM options AS a CROSS JOIN options AS b
WHERE a.slot_no = 1 AND b.slot_no = 2 AND (a.source_id = 'BUY' OR a.source_id <> b.source_id)
ORDER BY purchase_cents, a.consumed + b.consumed, a.source_id COLLATE BINARY, b.source_id COLLATE BINARY
LIMIT 1"
}

)
SELECT e.exhibit_code AS east_exhibit, w.exhibit_code AS west_exhibit, e.east_visits + w.west_visits AS forecast_visits, east.source_id AS east_source, west.source_id AS west_source

  JOIN crate_group AS g ON g.group_key = r.group_key
  JOIN return_bay AS b ON b.bay_key = r.bay_key

), best AS (

  ORDER BY a.crate_metres + b.crate_metres, a.bay_key COLLATE BINARY, b.bay_key COLLATE BINARY
